headline: Trump and Mike Johnson think the AI industry is overreacting
summary: AI industry leaders like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Alphabet CEOs call for a slowdown in AI development. Donald Trump and Mike Johnson disagree, believing the industry is overreacting. Key figures publicly voiced support for pacing AI's frontier.

headline: Apple is reportedly working on iPhone game controllers
summary: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports Apple is developing two game controllers for iPhone. They are expected to be sold under the Beats brand. macOS code references also hint at first-party Apple controllers.

headline: The Units’ Digital Stimulation is synthpunk perfection
summary: The article reviews The Units' album "Digital Stimulation," calling it synthpunk perfection. The band was discovered via a podcast series on The Screamers. It combines elements of punk rock with synthesizers.

headline: Waymo pulls over, calls cops on riders with a ghost gun
summary: A Waymo robotaxi stopped and alerted police about its juvenile passengers in San Francisco. The riders were found with a loaded AR-style ghost gun and arrested. The incident highlights Waymo's autonomous safety features.

headline: Blizzard Insists There Are 'Many Reasons to Keep Playing' Diablo 4 as Fans Debate End of Expansions and Diablo 5 in 2029
summary: Blizzard maintains "bright support" for Diablo 4 despite community concerns. Fans are debating the news that no more expansions are planned for the game. The community also anticipates Diablo 5, rumored for 2029.

headline: 'They Helped Pay For Our Movie, So Thank You': Marvel's Blade Might Be Scrapped, But Mahershala Ali Says He's Grateful He Got a Year of Free Training
summary: Mahershala Ali expressed gratitude for a year of free physical training from Marvel. His preparation for the reportedly cancelled Blade movie helped fund his new film. Ali acknowledged the unexpected benefit despite Blade's uncertain future.

headline: The Best Books Of September 2026
summary: This article features a curated list of the best new books for September 2026. The selections cover various genres, including cyberpunk and fantasy. It highlights recommended reads for the month.

headline: The Last of Us Part 2 Multiplayer Mod Cancelled at Sony’s Request
summary: A PC multiplayer mod for The Last of Us Part 2 has been cancelled. Sony Interactive Entertainment requested the mod maker not to release the project. This prevents public access to the fan-made PvP content.

headline: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
summary: Russia struck a Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and European officials departed. The former UK PM condemned the strike as "warped logic." The incident occurred near the Polish border.

headline: Watch: Why Russian strike on train could be sign of escalation
summary: A Russian drone struck a train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials left. No casualties were reported from the incident. Experts suggest the strike could signal an escalation of conflict.

headline: MPs and Lords call for new law to address AI threat to human rights
summary: UK politicians (MPs and Lords) are advocating for new legislation concerning AI. They argue existing laws are insufficient to address human rights risks from AI. The call highlights growing concerns about AI's societal impact.

headline: Deep-fried food banned under new school dinner rules in England
summary: New school dinner rules in England will ban deep-fried foods. The government calls these changes "once-in-a-generation" for food standards. The aim is to improve the nutritional quality of school meals.
